pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped polygonal dark brown regions with high-contrast, jagged edges and sharp angular vertices. Spatial area is greater in the upper flank region than the lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored pathways forming a topological web between dark patches. Junction nodes are primarily trifurcated or quadrifurcated with consistent pixel thickness across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a dense, serrated silhouette with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks along the cervical and thoracic dorsal line.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized structural break or thinning of the mane density is visible at the junction where the neck meets the shoulder ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, dark avian organism (likely Buphagus) perched on the dorsal ridge at the posterior neck/shoulder transition.
